metadata.title: Phase 1A.2b1 R1 — callback provenance reconciliation
metadata.scope: Source-only follow-up to the exact 109 UNKNOWN_EFFECT_BOUNDARY records in phase1a2b1Closeout.bindingOutcomes.
metadata.generatedFrom: Current source tree plus the bounded R1 callback/caller trace captured in session evidence.

limitations: No runtime journey, HTTP request, persistence behavior, authorization rule, organization scope, audit effect, or integration was tested.
The original R1 trace-candidate category contains 77 records; an additive source-effect follow-up verifies 54 source-level effects, while 23 remain unproven.
Seventeen bindings have no in-repository component caller in the bounded source census; caller reachability and terminal effect remain unknown.
Optional callbacks absent or gated in the inspected callers were not converted into feature-readiness claims.
The two active visible-action callback omissions are source-proven findings and remain unfixed by design in this evidence-only task.
The 245 historical candidates outside accepted closure remain untouched.

sourceEffectFollowup.method: Direct inspection of the binding handler, active in-repository caller where present, forwarding path, and source-level terminal operation. This is not runtime proof.

verifiedBindings.sourceEffect: The provider passes advanceStep to OnboardingOverlay.onNext; advanceStep increments the persisted step and writes the user-scoped onboarding state to localStorage.

The error-state retry button calls refreshOrganizations, which delegates to loadUserOrganizations; the authenticated path requests GET /api/users/me/organizations and updates organization context state.

The no-organization button calls refreshOrganizations, which delegates to loadUserOrganizations; the authenticated path requests GET /api/users/me/organizations and updates organization context state.
The action column calls handleToggle; it sends PATCH /api/targets/{id} with isActive and reloads target summary data.
The active dashboard form submits through form.handleSubmit(onSubmit); onSubmit sends POST /api/committees or PATCH /api/committees/{id}, then closes the dialog and refreshes committee data.
The active dashboard form submits through form.handleSubmit(onSubmit); onSubmit sends POST /api/bargaining-units or PATCH /api/bargaining-units/{id}, then closes the dialog and refreshes unit data.
The active dashboard form submits through form.handleSubmit(onSubmit); onSubmit sends POST /api/worksites or PATCH /api/worksites/{id}, then closes the dialog and refreshes worksite data.
The active dashboard form submits through form.handleSubmit(onSubmit); onSubmit sends POST /api/employers or PATCH /api/employers/{id}, then closes the dialog and refreshes employer data.
The comparison view receives handleRemoveFromComparison; invocation filters the selected precedent ID from local React state.
The active viewer receives handleDownloadDocument; for the decision document it opens the selected precedent's decisionDocumentUrl in a new browser tab when the URL exists.
The active viewer receives handleDownloadDocument; for the redacted document it opens the selected precedent's redactedDocumentUrl in a new browser tab when the URL exists.
PlatformOverview receives setSelectedOrg as onSelectOrg; invocation stores the selected organization ID in local React state.
TopicPill forwards its click callback to the active topic handler, which updates active-topic/query state and starts POST /api/exit-interviews/search for the selected domain.
The topic handler updates active-topic/query state and starts POST /api/exit-interviews/search for the selected domain.
The routed HazardsList caller supplies handleViewHazard; invocation navigates to /dashboard/health-safety/hazards/{hazardId}.
The routed HazardsList caller supplies handleViewHazard; invocation navigates to /dashboard/health-safety/hazards/{hazardId}.
The active hazards page supplies handleReportSubmit; form submission sends POST /api/health-safety/hazards with the organization ID, then closes the form and reloads summary data on an OK response.
The active hazards page supplies an onCancel callback that sets showReportForm to false.
The active new-incident page supplies handleSubmit; form submission sends POST /api/health-safety/incidents with the form data and then routes to the incidents list on an OK response.
The active new-incident page supplies onCancel, which routes to /dashboard/health-safety/incidents.
The status action calls advanceStatus, which sends PATCH /api/grievances/{id}/status and updates the grievance status in local state when response data is present.
The collaborator revoke action calls revokeCollaborator, which sends PATCH /api/grievances/{id}/access with status revoked and then refetches grievance data.
The action calls handleLink, which sends POST /api/grievances/{grievanceId}/suggest-clauses with the search text and selected clause ID; on an OK response it invokes the optional onLink callback.
The action calls handleAssign, which sends POST /api/grievances/{grievanceId}/assign with the selected steward ID; on an OK response it invokes the supplied onAssign callback.
SnapshotRow invokes the supplied callback, which sets the selected snapshot in local React state.
The detail close action invokes onClose, which clears the selected snapshot in local React state.
The active PolicyRegistry caller supplies onClose to clear the selected policy in local React state.
The node click toggles the selected node in local React state and forwards the node to the active caller, which stores it in local React state.
The active ExpertiseMap caller supplies onToggle to set or clear the expanded domain ID in local React state.
The action calls handleTransition, which sends PATCH /api/content/templates/{itemId}/status and refreshes the route on an OK response.
At step 1 the action invokes onCancel, supplied by SmsConsole to switch to its dashboard view; at later steps it decrements the current-step state.
The calendar action invokes the supplied onViewInspection callback; the active inspections page sets the selected inspection ID in local React state.
The active incidents page supplies handleViewIncident, which routes to /dashboard/health-safety/incidents/{incidentId}.
The card option invokes handlePaymentMethodSelected('card'), which sends POST /api/payments/checkout/create and redirects to the validated checkout URL when present.
The active dues portal supplies onReportIssue to set the selected deduction ID in local React state for the report-issue view.
The active ErrorState caller supplies fetchPropagation; retry requests GET /api/exit-interviews/propagation, maps the response into graph data, and updates loading/error/data state.
The playback control switches local playing state; playback advances the current week on an interval, while pause stops the interval.

The active classification dialog submits through createJobClassificationAction or updateJobClassificationAction; on success it calls onClose(true), which closes the dialog and reloads the classification list.
The dialog cancel control invokes handleDialogClose, which closes the dialog and clears the editing classification in local React state.
The active OrgContextForm caller routes the selection to handleOptionSelect, which updates the current section answer map in local React state.
The active OrgContextForm caller routes the selection to handleOptionSelect, which updates the current section answer map in local React state.
The organization-context form submits values to handleOrgContext, which stores the context, computes adaptive question routing with a static-bank fallback, and advances the assessment to step 2.
The active ICRA flow supplies handleConsent; the proceed action stores consent and the optional Turnstile token in local state, then advances to organization-context step 1.
The active calendar page supplies setSyncManagerOpen as onOpenChange; the close button sets the sync-manager dialog open state to false.
The active calendar page supplies setEventDialogOpen as onOpenChange; the close button sets the event-dialog open state to false.
The sidebar selection callback is wired to setSelectedCalendarId on the active calendar page, which stores the selected calendar ID in local React state.
The sidebar selection callback is wired to setSelectedCalendarId on the active calendar page, which stores the selected calendar ID in local React state.
The calendar row invokes onSelect(calendar.id); the active page wires onSelectCalendar to setSelectedCalendarId, updating local React state.

The row sync control invokes onSync(calendar.id); the active calendar page resolves the connection and requests POST /api/calendar-sync/connections/{connectionId}/sync with local and external calendar IDs.
The active calendar page supplies a no-op onDateClick and handleCreateEvent as onCreateEvent; clicking an empty day therefore opens the event dialog with that date as its initial value.
The month-view event control forwards the selected event to the active page's handleEditEvent, which stores the event in local state and opens the event dialog.
The week-view event control forwards the selected event to the active page's handleEditEvent, which stores the event in local state and opens the event dialog.
The day-view event control forwards the selected event to the active page's handleEditEvent, which stores the event in local state and opens the event dialog.
The agenda-view event control forwards the selected event to the active page's handleEditEvent, which stores the event in local state and opens the event dialog.

No source-effect conclusion is made for the remaining 23 trace-candidate records or the 17 no-caller records.
